title: Strict Iterator Model Map
scope: Strict iterator models complete at M6 2a-M; public T-ITER pending 2a-E; named-policy pending 2b

claims.claim: MFr independently constructs the complete Strict constructor result: model Info, raw num_plays, returned-frame prefix, every whole-canvas byte, rectangle, raw delay/dispose/blend and the terminal Iend or first frame-data error. The native history is not an input to the definitions.

The fold starts at transparent black and computes each before-draw canvas by canonical preceding-frame disposal, then paints independent P11/P13 source pixels with canonical SOURCE/OVER. It keeps the prior before-draw reference independently from Saved and never applies the last frame disposal after its display.

The accepted M5 MK relation uniquely determines the pointwise canonical paint result at every byte, using accepted source-pixel observations inside the rectangle and the drawing footprint outside it. No canvas is chosen from MK.

For every length of an accepted M5 canvas trace, induction identifies each actual before-draw/reference and returned canvas with the independently computed fold. With the independent successful data prefix, that trace equals the corresponding complete MFr frame prefix. This is a model-side composition theorem, not a newly exported public T-ITER contract.

For every actual input slice, no constructor or terminal OutsideDomain marker is reachable. The certificate walks, selects validated sources and measures them through existing contracts using one fixed WINDOW_MAX stack window. It never assumes successful frame data, allocation success or a valid input, and never constructs a native canvas/frame output.

For every returned model frame and every local source pixel, the accepted P13 source-pixel result is Ok. The selectors used by the canonical paint therefore do not leave returned pixels unconstrained.

The existing frozen global SavedAt projects exactly onto the complete frame prefix with k <= returned-frame count, not k < count. A least qualifying PREVIOUS frame whose data fails at k has SavedAt=k, exactly k returned frames and the same terminal error; reservation may precede and displace that error.

Every model frame has exactly 4*W*H physical bytes bounded by MAX_OUTPUT. Every channel of a pixel outside all rectangles drawn so far is zero. Raw is at least two bytes and obeys the accepted maximum/MAX_BYTES bounds; all fitting subframes use a Raw prefix; Output/Saved have the bounded full-canvas size.

The model Info comparison has frozen P8.3 granularity. num_plays is None without acTL and otherwise the raw u32; delay is None for a static frame and otherwise the raw fcTL u16 pair. Returned dispose/blend remain raw, distinct from frame-zero effective disposal used by the fold.

dependency_graph.edge: MFr/record -> mathematical MWF, default/frame data prefix, canonical fold
dependency_graph.meaning: Definitions depend on input, checked mathematical document/control fields, P11/P13 source equations and canonical disposal/OVER. They do not call native decoders, inspect a history, invoke the certificate or choose an MK output.

dependency_graph.edge: canonical fold -> prepared prior model state + independent source pixels -> new pointwise draw
dependency_graph.meaning: The displayed canvas and before-draw reference are computed recursively from model state alone. M5 geometry/control helpers read mathematical Doc fields, not native Trace/Saved state.

dependency_graph.edge: accepted MK -> mk_deterministic -> canonical draw equality
dependency_graph.meaning: Existing M5 full-pixel observations and footprint determine every byte. This theorem points from the accepted relation to an already defined function; it does not define the function from the relation.

dependency_graph.edge: M5 trace wf + independent data prefix -> induction -> complete MFr prefix equality
dependency_graph.meaning: For reused frame zero the native initial decoded buffer is not identified with logical transparent black; the accepted reuse equation supplies that bridge. Later references use the independently derived preceding before-draw canvas, not arbitrary Saved contents.

dependency_graph.edge: model_totality -> callers::frames + constructor_info + checked FrameState selection contracts
dependency_graph.meaning: The certificate receives either an actual walk error or a checked document. It selects all structurally validated frame sources, even if earlier measured data fails, solely to exclude internal domain markers; it does not simulate or replace the shipping iterator.

One fixed WINDOW_MAX stack window is reused with actual source readers and exact frame limits. status_eq excludes OutsideDomain for every native status, including format errors and Full; no successful-inflate or allocation premise is assumed.

dependency_graph.edge: two defining-module proof bridges -> existing opaque source/job invariants
dependency_graph.meaning: Only source_context and measure_context are added to frame_state.rs. They reveal existing invariant facts in their defining module; existing algorithms, contracts and public APIs are unchanged.

dependency_graph.edge: model_theorems -> checked totality certificate + pure metadata/source/resource lemmas
dependency_graph.meaning: The theorem has no input or allocation-success precondition. Constructor and terminal domain markers are both excluded; keeping a terminal marker in the internal projection avoids requiring a future-frame shipping prepass in 2a-E.
